response.subject: Return stay November 20–22 (2 adults): evening boat, tea gathering, and dinner note

segments.text: Mia and Victor would love to stay at HOSHINOYA Kyoto again this autumn.
We are hoping to come Friday, November 20 to Sunday, November 22 (2 adults: Mia & Victor).

We're following up on three things:

1. Evening boat:
We saw that a special 6:30 PM autumn leaves evening boat runs every night from November 10 to December 5. Could we reserve it for one of the evenings during our stay?
We'd also love to join the autumn leaves tea gathering in the Shoin on Saturday, November 21 at 3:00 PM, if there is still space for two of the 8 guests.
As before, Victor prefers not to have raw shellfish, so please keep that in mind for our dinners.
Could you let us know room availability and rates for those dates, and whether the boat and tea gathering can be booked now?
